name: mcdse-save-editor
description: Read and edit Minecraft Dungeons character save files (.dat encrypted / .json). Lists detected saves, shows items/currencies/level, adds/edits/moves items, and writes back in the original format.

tools.name: detect_save_files
tools.description: List save files found on this machine

tools.name: save_info
tools.description: Summary: level, xp, power, currencies, equipped items

tools.name: add_item
tools.description: Add an item by game id

tools.name: move_item
tools.description: Move an item between inventory and chest

tools.name: save
tools.description: Write the modified save back to disk
